I am calculating the total number of  *regionally elevated* genes in the **forebrain**, including the cerebral cortex, basal ganglia, thalamus and hypothalamus, for pigs, humans and mice
```{r}
mouse<- sum(55,185,60,98)
pig<- sum(109,157,31,45)
human <- sum(180,83,57,110)
print(paste('Mice, pigs and humans have', mouse,',', pig,'and', human, 'regionally elevated genes in the forebrain respectively' ))
install.packages("styler")
```
Therefore, humans have the highest level of regionally elevated genes in the forebrain
